about: The coordinator's THE ADDING RULE version 2 (28 Sep 17:30, dispatch/rule-adding-v2.md), as cases for the next round, labelled the way version 2 decides them and committed before any run. Same shape as take-away-labels.json: each clause, cut the way DescribedSteps.Cut cuts, is labelled with the op it must draft ({op}) or noAdd (any step or a placeholder, never a template that adds). Groups: framing verbs (make sure, ensure, check that, see that: the action is what follows), a take-away sign anywhere in the clause as a veto, no fuzzy match of an action verb, polite or leading adds kept, a clause with its own take-away action never inheriting an add, and the builder's five labelled phrasings whose label version 2 changes (vn-15, vn-20 and vn-21 carry a take-away sign, so version 2 drafts no add; new-08 says make, which version 2 counts as adding; new-24's second clause has no action of its own and inherits the add). sol-fixes VR5's five phrasings and VR6's four are here too. v2-14's second clause starts with an adding word inside a name; version 2's text does not settle it, and it is labelled with what the person asked for.
